evidence_quotes: Valmet will deliver a recovery boiler modification including a new secondary superheater to Stora Enso’s Varkaus Mill in Finland.
In addition, Stora Enso and Valmet have signed a three-year cooperation agreement covering process monitoring and operator training
data.date_evidence: Valmet Oyj’s trade press release on August 28, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. EEST
data.reason: The article reports on a new contract for a recovery boiler modification and a cooperation agreement between Valmet and Stora Enso.
